description: Remote `npm install && npm run build` of your edited files (send every file). Call with files -> WAIT + jobId; call again with jobId -> OK or FAIL with the error tail. Needs a purchased projectid.

envVariables.description: Env var names to write placeholder values for before building (typically get_component's `envVariables` output) — needed for components that read process.env at build time (e.g. a Supabase client).

files.description: The full project to verify — a scaffold's files with your edits applied. Omit when polling with jobId.

jobId.description: Poll a previously started verification. Omit on the first call (pass files), pass the returned jobId on subsequent calls.

projectid.description: The project id from a previous purchase_scaffold result — must be owned by this account. Required.

name: verify_scaffold
title: Verify scaffold
